limitation: Paired validity requires identically ordered QE and MSP scores for each evaluation split.
leakage_control: Frozen CNN and frozen historical QE scores; no fitting, threshold tuning, or final MNIST test data used.
alignment_evidence: Historical QE and current MSP use the same frozen checkpoint, SVHN official test dataset and transformation, and unshuffled dataset order. Matching method AUROCs independently verified. No per-sample identifiers were saved with the historical QE arrays.
